⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

When former executives trading power suits for paintbrushes are found murdered in scenes mocking their creative endeavors, FBI Agent Kate Wise must decode why those seeking authentic passion are dying—before another victim’s attempt at meaningful reinvention becomes their last.

IF SHE WATCHED (A Kate Wise Mystery) is the eighteenth book in a new psychological thriller series by bestselling author Blake Pierce, whose #1 bestseller Once Gone (a free download) has received over 1,000 five star reviews. The series begins with IF SHE KNEW (Book #1).

An action-packed thriller with heart-pounding suspense, IF SHE WATCHED is book #18 in a riveting new series that will leave you turning pages late into the night.

Future books in the series are now available!
